name: agent-debugging
description: Debug a failed AI agent run from agent traces, logs, configuration, transcripts and output files; find the supported fault and get a repair or reproducible escalation. Diagnose an agent loop, an agent stuck repeating a tool call, wrong tool calls, unsupported answers, runtime failures and falsely claimed completion. Get a minimal patch, corrected call or upstream issue report, then check the repaired task against the actual artifacts and receipts.
